_howToAdd: Add an object to projects or dashboards. Required project fields: id, name, url, icon, desc. Optional: nav, tagline, version, canvas, featured, bot, botId. Dashboards need id, name, nav, desc and either url or editions: [{id, label, date, url, summary, newest}]. Set shortcut: true to pin a dashboard in the sidebar. Set attention: true for a gold attention cue. Skip keys that start with _.
